audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Exodus / Shemot tabernacle construction and inventory text tradition, draft aligned to public-domain comparison layer later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for bronze altar, basin from serving women mirrors, court, screen, and material inventory by Ithamar.

verses.restored: He made altar of burnt offering of acacia wood: five cubits its length and five cubits its width, square, and three cubits its height.

familiar.text: And he made the altar of burnt offering of shittim wood: five cubits was the length thereof, and five cubits the breadth thereof; it was foursquare; and three cubits the height thereof.

verses.restored: He made its horns on its four corners; its horns were from it, and he overlaid it with bronze.

familiar.text: And he made the horns thereof on the four corners of it; the horns thereof were of the same: and he overlaid it with brass.

verses.restored: He made all vessels of altar: pots, shovels, basins, forks, and firepans; all its vessels he made bronze.

familiar.text: And he made all the vessels of the altar, the pots, and the shovels, and the basons, and the fleshhooks, and the firepans: all the vessels thereof made he of brass.

verses.restored: He made for altar grating, network of bronze, under its ledge from below to its middle.

familiar.text: And he made for the altar a brasen grate of network under the compass thereof beneath unto the midst of it.

verses.restored: He cast four rings on four ends of bronze grating, as housings for poles.

familiar.text: And he cast four rings for the four ends of the grate of brass, to be places for the staves.

verses.restored: He made poles of acacia wood and overlaid them with bronze.

familiar.text: And he made the staves of shittim wood, and overlaid them with brass.

verses.restored: He brought poles into rings on sides of altar, to carry it with them; hollow with boards he made it.

familiar.text: And he put the staves into the rings on the sides of the altar, to bear it withal; he made the altar hollow with boards.

verses.restored: He made bronze basin and its bronze stand from mirrors of serving women who served at entrance of tent of meeting.

familiar.text: And he made the laver of brass, and the foot of it of brass, of the lookingglasses of the women assembling, which assembled at the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.

verses.restored: He made court: for south side, hangings of court of fine twisted linen, one hundred cubits.

familiar.text: And he made the court: on the south side southward the hangings of the court were of fine twined linen, an hundred cubits:

verses.restored: Their twenty pillars and twenty bases were bronze; hooks of pillars and their bands silver.

familiar.text: Their pillars were twenty, and their brasen sockets twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets were of silver.

verses.restored: For north side, one hundred cubits, their twenty pillars and twenty bases bronze; hooks of pillars and bands silver.

familiar.text: And for the north side the hangings were an hundred cubits, their pillars were twenty, and their sockets of brass twenty; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

verses.restored: For west side, hangings fifty cubits, their ten pillars and ten bases; hooks of pillars and their bands silver.

familiar.text: And for the west side were hangings of fifty cubits, their pillars ten, and their sockets ten; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver.

verses.restored: For east side, toward sunrise, fifty cubits.

familiar.text: And for the east side eastward fifty cubits.

verses.restored: Hangings for one shoulder were fifteen cubits, their three pillars and three bases.

familiar.text: The hangings of the one side of the gate were fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.restored: For second shoulder on this and that of gate of court, hangings fifteen cubits, their three pillars and three bases.

familiar.text: And for the other side of the court gate, on this hand and that hand, were hangings of fifteen cubits; their pillars three, and their sockets three.

verses.restored: All hangings of court around were fine twisted linen.

familiar.text: All the hangings of the court round about were of fine twined linen.

verses.restored: Bases for pillars were bronze; hooks of pillars and their bands silver; overlay of their tops silver, and all pillars of court were banded with silver.

familiar.text: And the sockets for the pillars were of brass; the hooks of the pillars and their fillets of silver; and the overlaying of their chapiters of silver; and all the pillars of the court were filleted with silver.

verses.restored: Screen of gate of court was work of embroiderer, blue, purple, scarlet, and fine twisted linen; twenty cubits length and height in width five cubits, corresponding to hangings of court.

familiar.text: And the hanging for the gate of the court was needlework, of blue, and purple, and scarlet, and fine twined linen: and twenty cubits was the length, and the height in the breadth was five cubits, answerable to the hangings of the court.

verses.restored: Their four pillars and four bases were bronze, their hooks silver, overlay of their tops and bands silver.

familiar.text: And their pillars were four, and their sockets of brass four; their hooks of silver, and the overlaying of their chapiters and their fillets of silver.

verses.restored: All pegs of dwelling-place and court around were bronze.

familiar.text: And all the pins of the tabernacle, and of the court round about, were of brass.

verses.restored: These are counted things of dwelling-place, dwelling-place of testimony, which were counted by mouth of Moses, service of Levites by hand of Ithamar son of Aaron the priest.

familiar.text: This is the sum of the tabernacle, even of the tabernacle of testimony, as it was counted, according to the commandment of Moses, for the service of the Levites, by the hand of Ithamar, son to Aaron the priest.

verses.restored: Bezalel son of Uri son of Hur, of tribe of Judah, made all that YHWH commanded Moses.

familiar.text: And Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah, made all that the LORD commanded Moses.

verses.restored: With him Oholiab son of Ahisamach, of tribe of Dan, engraver, designer, and embroiderer in blue, purple, scarlet, and fine linen.

familiar.text: And with him was Aholiab, son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan, an engraver, and a cunning workman, and an embroiderer in blue, and in purple, and in scarlet, and fine linen.

verses.restored: All gold used for work, in all work of holy place, gold of wave offering, was twenty-nine talents and seven hundred thirty shekels, by sanctuary shekel.

familiar.text: All the gold that was occupied for the work in all the work of the holy place, even the gold of the offering, was twenty and nine talents, and seven hundred and thirty shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary.

verses.restored: Silver of counted ones of congregation was one hundred talents and one thousand seven hundred seventy-five shekels, by sanctuary shekel.

familiar.text: And the silver of them that were numbered of the congregation was an hundred talents, and a thousand seven hundred and threescore and fifteen shekels, after the shekel of the sanctuary:

verses.restored: A beka per head, half shekel by sanctuary shekel, for everyone passing over to counted ones from twenty years and upward, for six hundred three thousand five hundred fifty.

familiar.text: A bekah for every man, that is, half a shekel, after the shekel of the sanctuary, for every one that went to be numbered, from twenty years old and upward, for six hundred thousand and three thousand and five hundred and fifty men.

verses.restored: One hundred talents of silver were for casting bases of holy place and bases of veil; one hundred bases for one hundred talents, a talent per base.

familiar.text: And of the hundred talents of silver were cast the sockets of the sanctuary, and the sockets of the vail; an hundred sockets of the hundred talents, a talent for a socket.

verses.restored: From one thousand seven hundred seventy-five he made hooks for pillars, overlaid their tops, and banded them.

familiar.text: And of the thousand seven hundred seventy and five shekels he made hooks for the pillars, and overlaid their chapiters, and filleted them.

verses.restored: Bronze of wave offering was seventy talents and two thousand four hundred shekels.

familiar.text: And the brass of the offering was seventy talents, and two thousand and four hundred shekels.

verses.restored: With it he made bases for entrance of tent of meeting, bronze altar, bronze grating for it, and all vessels of altar,

familiar.text: And therewith he made the sockets to the door of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the brasen altar, and the brasen grate for it, and all the vessels of the altar,

verses.restored: bases of court around, bases of gate of court, all pegs of dwelling-place, and all pegs of court around.

familiar.text: And the sockets of the court round about, and the sockets of the court gate, and all the pins of the tabernacle, and all the pins of the court round about.

translation_notes: Bronze basin is made from mirrors of women serving at tent entrance; preserve women's contribution and service.
Inventory by Ithamar emphasizes accountability for sacred materials.
Census silver becomes structural bases; equal half-shekel life-value supports the holy place.
safety_note: Sacred materials are counted transparently. This resists spiritualized financial opacity and honors every contribution, including women’s mirrors transformed into washing basin.
